lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Transporting Cargo, Safety Chains & Towing Laws
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.409, how must trailer safety chains be properly attached?

options.text: Wrapped tightly around the rear vehicle axle housing without slack
Draped loosely on the ground pavement to discharge static electricity
Attached strictly to the decorative chrome rear bumper license frame
Crossed underneath the trailer tongue to cradle it if the hitch uncouples
